Agent note — triage of record (task 19074, lane any-l)

State: triaged. Issue #9989 OPEN, no labels, no hard-stop labels (fresh check 2026-11-17).

Verdict:
- Work kind: small-fix (implementation). Priority: normal — PM stack is a named program (drew-priorities-brief line 4); no expedite. Effort: l. Kind: enhancement.
- Design is merged: PR #9987 (2026-11-14) landed doc/2026-11-14T12-54-00Z_design_pm_stack_slo_watchdog; this issue is its section 7 follow-on 2, scoped by section 2 of that note.
- Confirmed unimplemented on main 09ae3a8ce9: no remediation executor exists in pm-stack. Watchdog detection/episodes exist (aggregator watchdog, activity.ts watchdog-event stream); nothing executes catalogue actions, caps, cooldowns, or circuit breakers.
- Siblings are independent, not gates: #9991 (follow-on 4, escalation router) and #9992 (follow-on 5, heartbeat/self-failure checker) are OPEN; neither blocks the executor.
- Hard design constraint carried into the packet: stateful services (Pad/Grist, databases) are never auto-restarted — escalate only.

Follow-on: task 20452 (small_fix, queued) — implement the section 2 catalogue executor with preconditions (facet bad, no deploy in progress), per-action caps/cooldowns, global daily caps, per-facet circuit breakers (open after 3 exhausted incidents/24h), deploy-lock refusal logged, plus tests.

Acceptance check for the fix: catalogue actions run only inside caps/cooldowns; breaker opens after 3 exhausted incidents/24h; deploy-lock attempts refused and logged; tests pass; PR merged, issue closed with evidence.
